name: newestetica
description: Sistema para clínica de estética da Fabiana Rosa - foco em mulheres 40+

scripts.lint: node --check lint-staged.config.mjs && pnpm --filter frontend --filter contracts --filter backend lint
scripts.format: pnpm --filter frontend exec prettier --check ../lint-staged.config.mjs && pnpm --filter frontend --filter contracts --filter backend format
scripts.build: pnpm --filter contracts build && pnpm --filter frontend build && pnpm --filter backend build
